svg.title: Auxiliary-variable domain bridge
svg.desc: A changed even-power equation introduces y=x squared, keeps the real-domain image y nonnegative visible, filters candidate y values and returns to x.

g.text: Let y=x^2. Because x is real, carry y ≥ 0.
Solve the quadratic in y, then filter candidate y-values through y ≥ 0.
Map only admissible y-values back to real x.
Finish by substituting accepted x-values into the original polynomial.
